name: Nyamien
description: Star of 6,300 K, 282 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-15 b crosses Nyamien as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: WASP-15
quotes.card: WASP-15, also named Nyamien, is a magnitude 11 star located about 935 light-years away in the constellation Centaurus.
quotes.introduction: The star, which is more massive, larger, hotter, and more luminous than the Sun, is also less metal-rich than the Sun.
